'''Cynner''' was a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] employee of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Lestra Oxic]]. He worked for the attorney, providing security and covert services as one of his agents. In [[43 ABY]], he was assigned to the pursuit of [[Tobb Jadak]] along with [[Remata]].
